_about: The one pin of Angelo's agent runtime: the patched OpenAI Codex build the app bundles (agent_runtime.py; doc/angelo/gpt_launch.rst, 'Agent runtime and prompt caching'). The app refuses a runtime that reports another version or lacks a listed feature; build_files/cmake/angelo_agent_runtime.cmake installs exactly the listed files, and a release build (ANGELO_REQUIRE_AGENT_RUNTIME) also its release_marker, which makes the app refuse a path in ANGELO_AGENT_RUNTIME; the release checks and the signer read the same lists. On Windows, upstream_signed names OpenAI's unchanged release executables, which ship with OpenAI's own Authenticode signature (upstream_signer): the signer keeps it and refuses to sign over it, and signs the rest (codex.exe, Angelo's build); macOS re-signs every file. Change a value here, nowhere else.
name: OpenAI Codex

fork._public_commit: The published branch's head: the same tree as commit, the one the bundled codex was built from.
